intended_object: A canonical isomorphism of affine group schemes over R. The relative quotient Spec of the weight-parabolic coordinate Hopf algebra by the image of the weight-unipotent ideal is identified with the weight-unipotent group scheme cut out directly in GL_N. Inferred from the docstring and the body.
explanation: The body applies `hopfSpec` to (the opposite of) `weightUnipotentInParabolicCoordinateIso`. That isomorphism is an `eqToIso`, coming from the fact that pulling the relative ideal back recovers the original one, composed with `quotientIsoOfSurjective`; in other words it is the third isomorphism theorem (A/J)/(I/J) ≅ A/I for Hopf quotients, carried over to Spec. It is the right canonical identification and matches its docstring. But it is only glue between two library-internal constructions of the same subgroup scheme U_w ⊂ P_w ⊂ GL_N. The library uses the coordinate version of it to move properties such as smoothness, connectedness and points across the two encodings. It does not formalize a standalone mathematical notion from the literature.
